news.headline:
L&T recommended as 'Buy' due to strong international division, govt capex; RIL advised 'Hold' with potential rebound above Rs 1,400.
Wipro, Vikram Solar advised 'Sell'; Zee Ent 'Hold' to minimize losses; Hindustan Copper 'Can add' via SIP for long-term potential.

Reliance Industries saw an NSE block trade for 911,945 shares at Rs. 1301.20.
The trade value of Reliance Industries shares totaled Rs. 118.66 crore.

Reliance Industries faces Sebi warning over alleged insider trading.
Reliance shares remain in focus amidst regulatory scrutiny.

12 large-cap stocks, including Max Financial, Reliance, Jio Financial, identified with up to 29% upside.
Categories include 'Buy' and 'Strong Buy'; further details available in the listed link.

Reliance Industries & Adani Total Gas are poised to benefit from India's CBG blending mandate.
Policy aims to drive Rs 37,500 crore investments and set up 750 CBG plants by FY29.
Reliance Industries warned by SEBI over employee trades during UPSI period.

SEBI issued an administrative warning to Reliance over employee dealings in its scrip.
Reliance has issued a response to SEBI's warning, details yet unclear.

SEBI warns RIL for insider trading in July 2024 involving three individuals.
No financial penalties imposed; RIL urged to improve compliance measures.

Reliance Industries shows short-term downtrend break with support holding.
Bullish MACD crossover, rising RSI, and higher lows indicate consolidation.

Jio Platforms IPO DRHP reveals plans for India's massive public offering; RIL retains 66.4% stake pre-issue.
IPO proceeds to repay RJIL's borrowings, fund corporate purposes; Jio leads in broadband, 5G spectrum, and AI services.
Reliance shares rebound 2%, trading above the 20-day moving average.

Anti-dumping duty on LLDPE imports from UAE, Saudi Arabia, and others may benefit Indian Oil, HPCL, and RIL.
The move could support domestic petrochemical businesses, aiding companies like Indian Oil, HPCL, and Reliance Ind.

RIL extends CBM production contract worth Rs 166.8 crore with SWPE.
Revenue generation expected from Q2 FY 2026-27; no new assets needed.

Top 10 under-owned Indian stocks, incl. RIL, TCS, ITC, see 2-decade low FII holdings at 34% avg, per DSP report.
India's valuation premium over EM hit a historic low; MOFSL sees AI trade rotation as a risk, boosting Indian equities.

Rayalaseema sees proposed investments of ₹4.5 trn across 275 projects.
Projects may generate 3.5 lakh jobs; Reliance, JSW involved.

Mcap of 6 top-10 firms surged ₹1L cr; Airtel gained ₹36.5K cr, Bajaj Finance ₹33.1K cr.
Sensex rose 0.86%, Nifty 0.89%; Reliance retained lead despite ₹18.9K cr decline.
FSSAI issues notices to Reliance, PepsiCo, and global beverage giants over energy drink concerns.

Reliance Industries now has a market value of ₹18 lakh crore, surpassing TCS.
Reliance's valuation equals the combined worth of India's five largest IT firms.

CARE Ratings reaffirmed 'CARE AAA (Stable)' and 'CARE A1+' for Reliance's NCDs and CPs.
This credit rating update was announced via Reliance Industries' official communication.

Mukesh Ambani-linked stocks showed negative returns, eroding investor wealth due to market volatility and sector-specific challenges.
Reliance Industries declined 14% YoY; other stocks like GTPL, Just Dial, and Network18 saw declines of 49%, 41%, and 43%, respectively.

Reliance's June MTF book grows to ₹1.35 lakh crore.
Reliance and HDFC Bank are among the top leveraged stocks.

MTF book grows to ₹1.35 lakh crore in June, up 6.9% MoM.
Reliance leads MTF positions; Persistent Systems sees 146% MoM jump.

Nifty 50 dropped nearly 500 points; Sensex fell over 1,600 points.
HDFC Bank, Reliance, ICICI, Airtel, L&T led Nifty's decline on Wednesday.

Bajaj Broking expert recommends Reliance, Bharti Airtel, BEL, HDFC Bank, ITC for short-term gains.
Stocks backed by technical analysis, favorable risk-reward; Nifty expected to trend higher despite consolidation.
